Help & Inquiries

Frequently Asked Questions

How does Nora's Roblox Group Verification work?
Members link their Roblox account using Nora's secure profile check (putting a unique phrase in their Roblox profile description). Once verified, Nora automatically syncs their server roles to their Roblox group ranks with zero delay.
Is Nora truly privacy-first?
Yes. Nora operates on a strict zero-telemetry architecture. We never store message contents, track user conversations, or sell data. All database records are strictly isolated per guild and encrypted.
How do I configure the new Starboard and Counting channels?
You can easily set them up in Discord using /starboard channel <#channel> and /counting channel <#channel>, or open the visual web dashboard at vaztinix.dev/dashboard under the Games tab!
Can I customize the trigger emojis and math rules?
Yes! Starboard supports custom server emojis, configurable thresholds (1-100), and self-star protection. The Counting game automatically evaluates math expressions such as 10*2+5, 50/2, and 2^4 safely.
